sentenceSets.sentence: His dictatorial management style eliminated dissent but also eliminated the diversity of thought that drives innovation.

answerChoices.reasoning: Authoritarian describes absolute power and control; while his management is authoritarian, dictatorial more specifically emphasizes the dominating, imperious manner rather than just absolute authority.
Tyrannical describes cruel and unjust rule; while his management is tyrannical, dictatorial focuses on the imperious manner of command rather than cruelty.
Autocratic describes rule by one person with absolute power; while his management is autocratic, dictatorial emphasizes the aggressive, dominating manner of exercising that power.
Despotic describes rule by a despot with absolute power; while his management is despotic, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious, dominating manner of command.
Bossy describes someone who is domineering or pushes others around; while his management is bossy, dictatorial conveys a more systematic, institutionalized style of command.
Controlling describes a need to dominate situations; while his management is controlling, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of authority more than the psychological need to control.
Overbearing describes being excessively dominant or intrusive; while applicable, it emphasizes rudeness or intrusiveness more than the systematic exercise of command.
Commanding describes having an impressive, authoritative manner; while his style is commanding, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious suppression of dissent more than authority.
Democratic means involving participation and equal voice; the sentence describes elimination of dissent, opposite to democracy.
Collaborative means working together with others; the sentence describes elimination of dissent and diversity.
Consultative means seeking input and advice; the sentence shows dissent being eliminated.

sentenceSets.sentence: The coach's dictatorial approach to practice left no room for individual creativity or player initiative.

answerChoices.reasoning: Strict describes enforcing rules rigorously; while the coach is strict, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious, dominating manner more than rule enforcement.
Rigorous describes thorough and demanding; while the coach is rigorous, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious suppression of player initiative more than demanding standards.
Rigid describes inflexibility and resistance to change; while the coach is rigid, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of command rather than inflexibility.
Controlling describes a need to dominate situations; while the coach is controlling, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of authority more than psychological need.
Demanding describes making difficult requirements; while the coach is demanding, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious suppression of creativity more than making requirements.
Inflexible describes unwillingness to adapt; while the coach is inflexible, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of command.
Authoritative describes having clear authority and confidence; while the coach is authoritative, dictatorial emphasizes imperious command and suppression of initiative.
Exacting describes making strict demands; while the coach is exacting, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner and suppression of creativity.
Permissive means allowing freedom and flexibility; the sentence describes elimination of creativity and player initiative.
Flexible means able to adapt and change; the sentence shows an inflexible, controlling approach.
Encouraging means supporting and inspiring effort; the sentence shows suppression of player initiative.

sentenceSets.sentence: The professor's dictatorial handling of classroom discussions—cutting off questions and declaring opinions wrong rather than debating them—earned him the nickname 'the dictator.'

answerChoices.reasoning: Imperious describes haughtily commanding manner; while his handling is imperious, dictatorial more specifically emphasizes the suppression of discussion and debate.
Authoritarian describes absolute power and control; while his handling is authoritarian, dictatorial emphasizes the specific manner of shutting down discussion.
Arbitrary describes decisions made without reason or fairness; while his handling is arbitrary in declaring opinions wrong, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of suppressing discussion.
Overbearing describes being excessively dominant or intrusive; while his handling is overbearing, dictatorial more specifically emphasizes the suppression of debate.
Dismissive describes treating something as unworthy of consideration; while he is dismissive, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner and suppression of dissent.
Arrogant describes excessive pride and self-importance; while he is arrogant, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of silencing rather than arrogance.
Condescending describes treating others as inferior; while his handling is condescending, dictatorial emphasizes the suppression of discussion.
Intolerant describes unwillingness to accept different views; while he is intolerant, dictatorial emphasizes the imperious manner of suppression.
Democratic means involving equal voice and participation; the sentence shows suppression of questions and debate.
Collaborative means working together; the sentence shows cutting off questions and debate.
Open-minded means willing to consider different ideas; the sentence shows dismissing opinions without debate.
